answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before it may trade, and bind that stake to one persistent identity checked by repeated peer attestation. A newcomer starts at the wharf with zero trust and only tiny deals, like a lotus opening slowly; each honest trade raises its limit, while one proven fraud slashes the whole stake and blacklists the identity. When a gale of fresh accounts floods the market, funding thousands of stakes costs more than any profit from fake volume, so Sybil swarms price themselves out.
